item.text: {"search_note":"I found strong evidence of targeted programs and rights language, but much of it is official output or self-reporting. Independent 2024 outcome evidence is thinner for the elderly, disabled people, and poor regions than for children and Indigenous communities. The clearest independent counterevidence is that Indigenous people, migrants, and poor children still faced major access gaps despite the state’s stated prioritization.","evidence":[{"title":"Gobierno de la transformación consolida Pensiones de Bienestar: Ariadna Montiel","publisher":"Secretaría de Bienestar","date":"2024-07-21","url":"https://www.gob.mx/bienestar/prensa/gobierno-de-la-transformacion-consolida-pensiones-de-bienestar-ariadna-montiel","summary":"The government said 12.2 million older adults received the pension for adults mayores and more than 1 million people received the disability pension, both delivered directly and framed as rights. This is direct evidence of prioritizing the elderly and disabled.","question_ids":["6B.3","6B.2"]},{"title":"Anuncia DIF Nacional acciones de protección a niñez migrante","publisher":"Sistema Nacional DIF","date":"2024-06-17","url":"https://www.gob.mx/difnacional/articulos/anuncia-dif-nacional-acciones-de-proteccion-a-ninez-migrante","summary":"DIF reported 88 active centers and 48,111 children served in 2024, with services for accompanied and unaccompanied migrant children and families. This is concrete prioritization of a highly vulnerable group.","question_ids":["6B.3","6B.2"]},{"title":"Se refuerza estrategia contra la violencia hacia las mujeres y niñas: SSPC","publisher":"Secretaría de Seguridad y Protección Ciudadana","date":"2024-08-06","url":"https://www.gob.mx/sspc/prensa/se-refuerza-estrategia-contra-la-violencia-hacia-las-mujeres-y-ninas-sspc","summary":"The federal government said it was reinforcing an anti-violence strategy for women and girls, with outreach, training for public servants and police, and a claimed feminicide decline versus 2018. This shows explicit attention to women and girls as priority groups.","question_ids":["6B.3"]},{"title":"Reforma en materia de pueblos indígenas y afromexicanos es un acto de justicia social","publisher":"Presidencia de México","date":"2024-02-21","url":"https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/reforma-en-materia-de-pueblos-indigenas-y-afromexicanos-es-un-acto-de-justicia-social/","summary":"AMLO backed constitutional recognition, self-determination, consultation rights, and budget authority for Indigenous and Afro-Mexican communities, including protections for women and migrant Indigenous communities. This is strong evidence of prioritizing marginalized ethnic groups.","question_ids":["6B.3","6B.2"]},{"title":"Programas como Producción para el Bienestar han reducido la brecha de desigualdad en el campo","publisher":"Secretaría de Agricultura y Desarrollo Rural","date":"2024-02-27","url":"https://www.gob.mx/agricultura/prensa/programas-como-produccion-para-el-bienestar-han-reducido-la-brecha-de-desigualdad-en-el-campo?idiom=es","summary":"The program explicitly prioritized Indigenous communities and small-scale producers, and 2024 resources included dedicated support for women producers. This supports a poor-region and rural-marginalization priority reading.","question_ids":["6B.3","6B.2"]},{"title":"Mexico approves historic legislation on the right to adequate and sustainable food","publisher":"FAO","date":"2024-04-19","url":"https://www.fao.org/right-to-food/news-and-events/news/news-detail/Mexico-approves-historic-legislation-on-the-right-to-adequate-and-sustainable-food/en","summary":"FAO said the new law prioritized health, environment, water, and children’s best interests in food policy, and aimed at equitable distribution of nutritious food. This is direct evidence of food-security prioritization for vulnerable people.","question_ids":["6B.3","6B.2"]},{"title":"Programa IMSS-Bienestar del Seguro Social atiende a casi 4 millones de indígenas con respeto a usos y costumbres","publisher":"IMSS","date":"2024-08-09","url":"https://www.gob.mx/imss/prensa/programa-imss-bienestar-del-seguro-social-atiende-a-casi-4-millones-de-indigenas-con-respeto-a-usos-y-costumbres","summary":"IMSS-Bienestar said it served nearly 4 million Indigenous people in 20 states, with free medicines and some staff speaking Indigenous languages. This is strong evidence of targeted health access for a marginalized group.","question_ids":["6B.3","6B.2"]},{"title":"La Escuela es Nuestra alcanza cobertura del 99 por ciento en planteles de educación básica","publisher":"Presidencia de México","date":"2024-06-26","url":"https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/la-escuela-es-nuestra-alcanza-cobertura-del-99-por-ciento-en-planteles-de-educacion-basica/","summary":"The administration said school infrastructure funding had reached 99% of basic-education schools, with direct parent committee control. This is relevant evidence that children and poor schools were a concrete policy focus.","question_ids":["6B.3","6B.2"]},{"title":"Pobreza infantil y adolescente en México-2022","publisher":"UNICEF México","date":"2024-10","url":"https://www.unicef.org/mexico/informes/pobreza-infantil-y-adolescente-en-m%C3%A9xico-2022","summary":"UNICEF said social programs helped reduce child poverty, but children remained the most affected group, Indigenous child poverty was especially severe, and further gains required universal programs plus quality services. This is mixed evidence: real prioritization, but outcomes remained uneven.","question_ids":["6B.3","6B.2"]},{"title":"Ninguna forma de discriminación racial debe existir","publisher":"SEGOB / CONAPRED","date":"2024-03-21","url":"https://www.gob.mx/segob/prensa/ninguna-forma-de-discriminacion-racial-debe-existir?idiom=en","summary":"The government itself acknowledged persistent barriers such as racial profiling, arbitrary detentions, invisibility of Afro-Mexicans, and obstacles to identity documents for Indigenous, migrant, and ethnic-minority people. That undercuts a clean claim that marginalized groups were consistently prioritized in practice.","question_ids":["6B.3","6B.2"]},{"title":"World Report 2024: Mexico","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024","url":"https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2024/country-chapters/mexico","summary":"HRW said migrants are preyed upon, Indigenous and Afro-Mexican people face disproportionate burdens, and women with disabilities face disproportionate violence. This is strong negative evidence that protection and access were not evenly delivered.","question_ids":["6B.3","6B.2"]},{"title":"Mexico's military role in migrant massacre comes under sharp scrutiny","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-10-16","url":"https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/mexico-militarys-role-in-migrant-massacre-comes-under-sharp-scrutiny-2024-10-16/","summary":"Reuters reported soldiers killed six migrants. That is direct evidence of a failure to protect a highly vulnerable group, cutting against a fully welfare- or vulnerability-centered reading.","question_ids":["6B.3","6B.2"]},{"title":"Evita fraudes, no hay entrega de apoyos durante el proceso electoral","publisher":"Programas para el Bienestar","date":"2024-03-18","url":"https://programasparaelbienestar.gob.mx/evita-fraudes-no-hay-entrega-de-apoyos-durante-el-proceso-electoral/","summary":"The government advanced welfare payments before the blackout period, which makes the timing look at least partly patronage-sensitive and electorally strategic. That weakens a pure vulnerable-groups-first interpretation.","question_ids":["6B.3","6B.2"]}]}
